description: Open a file from a GitHub repository in the PlainHub browser editor, or change editor settings (theme, fontSize, preview, sidebar, lineNumbers, whitespace, header) when called without repo and path. Use it when the user wants to see or edit a file in the browser. The browser signs in on its own; the saved token is handed over only when noAuth is false. Opens https://app.plainhub.dev unless PLAINHUB_APP_URL is set (lab or localhost; the token is only passed to https://app.plainhub.dev). Example: {"repo": "octocat/hello-world", "path": "README.md", "preview": "on"}

branch.description: Branch name (default: the repository's default branch)

noAuth.description: Set to false to hand the saved token to the page (default: the browser signs in on its own)

path.description: File path in the repository, e.g. docs/setup.md

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, e.g. octocat/hello-world

scroll.description: Scroll the preview to this heading (section name)

name: plainhub_open
